description: Source-grounded literature review for a quantitative-finance research question: ranked relevant papers, optional books, methodological comparison, supporting and contradictory evidence, limitations and open questions. Every claim cites corpus sources. Paid tool: $0.25 USDC per call via x402 v2 (solana). A call without payment returns a payment-required result.

inputSchema.description: Generate a source-grounded literature review for a quantitative-finance research question from the corpus.

include_books.description: Also list relevant books (catalogue metadata only).

output_format.description: markdown adds a rendered `markdown` field next to the structured sections.

research_question.description: Plain-language question of 10 to 500 characters; runs of whitespace are collapsed.
